class.name: OcgGpMat2d
class.brief_description: Describes a two column, two row matrix. This sort of object is used in various vectorial or matrix computations.
class.description: ! Describes a two column, two row matrix. ! This sort of object is used in various vectorial or matrix computations.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a matrix with null coefficients.

method.name: from_2
method.description: theCol1, theCol2 are the 2 columns of the matrix.

method.name: SetCol
method.description: Assigns the two coordinates of theValue to the column of range theCol of this matrix Raises OutOfRange if theCol < 1 or theCol > 2.

method.name: SetCols
method.description: Assigns the number pairs theCol1, theCol2 to the two columns of this matrix

method.name: SetDiagonal
method.description: Modifies the main diagonal of the matrix. The other coefficients of the matrix are not modified.

method.name: SetIdentity
method.description: Modifies this matrix, so that it represents the Identity matrix.

method.name: SetRotation
method.description: Modifies this matrix, so that it represents a rotation. theAng is the angular value in radian of the rotation.

method.name: SetRow
method.description: Assigns the two coordinates of theValue to the row of index theRow of this matrix. Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 2.

method.name: SetRows
method.description: Assigns the number pairs theRow1, theRow2 to the two rows of this matrix.

method.name: SetScale
method.description: Modifies the matrix such that it represents a scaling transformation, where theS is the scale factor :

method.name: SetValue
method.description: Assigns <theValue> to the coefficient of row theRow, column theCol of this matrix. Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 2 or theCol < 1 or theCol > 2

method.name: Column
method.description: Returns the column of theCol index. Raises OutOfRange if theCol < 1 or theCol > 2

method.name: Determinant
method.description: Computes the determinant of the matrix.

method.name: Diagonal
method.description: Returns the main diagonal of the matrix.

method.name: Row
method.description: Returns the row of index theRow. Raised if theRow < 1 or theRow > 2

method.name: ChangeValue
method.description: Returns the coefficient of range (theRow, theCol) Raises OutOfRange if theRow < 1 or theRow > 2 or theCol < 1 or theCol > 2

method.name: Added
method.description: Computes the sum of this matrix and the matrix theOther.for each coefficient of the matrix : Note: - operator += assigns the result to this matrix, while - operator + creates a new one.

method.name: Divided
method.description: Divides all the coefficients of the matrix by a scalar.

method.name: Inverted
method.description: Inverses the matrix and raises exception if the matrix is singular.

method.name: Multiply_1
method.description: Computes the product of two matrices <me> * <theOther>

method.name: PreMultiply
method.description: Modifies this matrix by premultiplying it by the matrix Other <me> = theOther * <me>.

method.name: Multiply_2
method.description: Multiplies all the coefficients of the matrix by a scalar.

method.name: Powered
method.description: computes <me> = <me> * <me> * .......* <me>, theN time. if theN = 0 <me> = Identity if theN < 0 <me> = <me>.Invert() *...........* <me>.Invert(). If theN < 0 an exception can be raised if the matrix is not inversible

method.name: Subtracted
method.description: Computes for each coefficient of the matrix :

method.name: Transposed
method.description: Transposes the matrix. A(j, i) -> A (i, j)
